patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I fell asleep at the beach and now my shoulders and back are bright red and sore. No blisters really, just red and hot. My wife told me to get it checked.
presentation.triageNote: 34-year-old male who fell asleep at the beach and now has painful, uniformly red skin across his shoulders and back. The skin is intact without blisters; vital signs are normal and he has no systemic symptoms.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this superficial sunburn has intact skin, normal vital signs, and no systemic illness, so no counted emergency resource is expected.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a large but superficial ultraviolet burn without blistering or systemic symptoms.
clinical.acuityReason: Uniform erythema with intact skin and stable physiology supports supportive outpatient care rather than burn-center treatment.
keyFindings: Normal vital signs and no systemic symptoms
teachingPoints: Blistering, dehydration, altered mental status, heat illness, or extensive deeper injury would change management.
Sun protection and hydration reduce recurrence and associated risk.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Cooling measures, moisturizer, oral analgesia, hydration, and sun-avoidance guidance would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 34-year-old man in a tank top, red shoulders
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding his shirt away from red shoulders
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 34-year-old man in a tank top with red sunburned shoulders, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: holding the shirt collar away from his red shoulders. Expression: a bit embarrassed, mild discomfort. Clearly visible: bright red sunburned shoulders. No text, no logos.
